definition: awake, responsive and quick to act

hints: Think of someone with very little energy.
They feel sluggish and struggle to get going.
Nine letters, beginning with L.
guide.explanation: LETHARGIC is an opposite adjective for ALERT. It contains every enemy letter.

definition: accurate and in accordance with the facts

hints: Think about a statement that gets the details wrong.
You might describe an unreliable measurement this way.
Ten letters, beginning with I.
guide.explanation: INACCURATE is an opposite adjective for TRUE. It contains every enemy letter.

hints: Think of someone who takes other people’s feelings into account.
They are thoughtful about the effect their actions have on others.
Eleven letters, beginning with C.
guide.explanation: CONSIDERATE is an opposite adjective for STERN. It contains every enemy letter.

hints: Think of the welcome you would like to get as a guest.
A host who makes strangers feel comfortable is this.
Ten letters, beginning with H.
guide.explanation: HOSPITABLE is an opposite adjective for HOSTILE. It contains every enemy letter.

hints: Think of someone with refined manners and tastes.
The same word can describe pearls grown by people.
Eight letters, beginning with C.
guide.explanation: CULTURED is an opposite adjective for RUDE. It contains every enemy letter.

hints: Think of something that has enough water in it.
The word is often used when talking about drinking enough water.
Eight letters, beginning with H.
guide.explanation: HYDRATED is an opposite adjective for DRY. It contains every enemy letter.

hints: Think of someone who notices another person’s suffering and cares.
It describes a person who feels sympathy and wants to help.
Thirteen letters, beginning with C.
guide.explanation: COMPASSIONATE is an opposite adjective for MEAN. It contains every enemy letter.

definition: a feeling of fear about what may happen

hints: Look for a noun meaning the absence of fear.
It names a quality, rather than describing a person.
Twelve letters, beginning with F. Use both blue tiles.
guide.explanation: FEARLESSNESS is an opposite noun for DREAD. The blue tiles cover the missing enemy letters.

definition: lasting forever; without an end in time

hints: Think of something that will not last.
It is the opposite of permanent.
Eleven letters, beginning with I. The blue P covers one missing letter.
guide.explanation: IMPERMANENT is an opposite adjective for ETERNAL. The blue tiles cover the missing enemy letters.

definition: causes plants to wither or dry out in the heat

hints: Look for another way to say supply water.
Farmers do this to fields when rain is not enough.
Nine letters, beginning with I. The blue G supplies the second S.
guide.explanation: IRRIGATES belongs to the “add water” counter family. The blue tiles cover the missing enemy letters.

hints: Every answer here is an action that cleans.
Think of cleaning equipment so that no germs remain.
Ten letters, beginning with S. Use the British spelling.
guide.explanation: STERILISED belongs to the “clean” counter family. It contains every enemy letter.

hints: Think of a place where nothing could get a drink.

Nine letters, beginning with W.

definition: making a lot of noise; high in volume

hints: Think of a scene you could watch but not hear.
The word describes a complete absence of noise.
Nine letters, beginning with S.
guide.explanation: SOUNDLESS is an opposite adjective containing every letter of LOUD.

hints: Think of a building after its lamps have been switched on.
This can also describe a decorated medieval manuscript.
Eleven letters, beginning with I.
guide.explanation: ILLUMINATED is an opposite adjective containing every letter of DIM.

definition: watery in consistency or low in density

hints: Think of what happens to a runny sauce as it cooks down.
An adjective for its changed consistency.
Nine letters, beginning with T.
guide.explanation: THICKENED is an opposite adjective containing every letter of THIN.

hints: Think of an amount too small to make much difference.
It is so slight that you could ignore it in a calculation.
Ten letters, beginning with N.
guide.explanation: NEGLIGIBLE is an opposite adjective containing every letter of BIG.

An adjective saying that a particular liquid is absent.
Nine letters, beginning with W.
guide.explanation: WATERLESS is an opposite adjective containing every letter of WET. It includes every required copy of the armoured letters.

definition: an anxious feeling in anticipation of danger

hints: Think of the quality that lets someone face danger without being afraid.
It names a quality, rather than describing a person.
Twelve letters, beginning with F.
guide.explanation: FEARLESSNESS is an opposite noun containing every letter of FEAR. It includes every required copy of the armoured letters.
